title: Hybrid System Identification of Electric Freight Transition Dynamics via SINDy and Neural ODEs
summary: The transition to electric heavy-duty freight is constrained by a strong interdependence between vehicle adoption and charging infrastructure deployment. While system dynamics models are well-suited to simulate these socio-technical feedback loops, their reliance on conditional logic and heuristic rules makes the underlying dynamics difficult to interpret mathematically. This limits the direct application of formal systems and control theory.
